summary: Tested unified 'My Pending Approvals' inbox — backend GET /api/my-inbox aggregation across 7 sources with role filtering, actionable approve loop, and frontend UI (page, KPI tiles, topbar bell, role-based visibility, regression). All 6 pytest cases pass; all frontend flows verified across super_admin / project_manager / sales_executive.
critical_code_review_comments: my_inbox_router: current_step defaults to 0 via `or 0` which incorrectly treats current_step=0 as falsy but that path returns 0 anyway — harmless. Consider explicit `int(row.get('current_step') or 0)` for clarity.

Counts in response are derived only from the returned items[] (capped at 300). If any single source exceeds its 200 cap AND cross-source total > 300, KPI totals may under-report. Currently well under cap; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Approved pending scaffolding transfer MTN-2026-0004 (as admin) as part of actionable-item E2E test; it correctly disappeared from /api/my-inbox afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter157_my_inbox.py covers inbox shape, counts-vs-items consistency, PM & Sales role filtering (forbidden sources absent), scaffolding approve E2E via approve_path, and 401 for unauth. FE verified: admin sees total=152 KPI matches API; PM=26 (only approval+dpr); Sales=38 (only approval). Topbar bell (my-approvals-btn) shows '9+' badge when total>9 (verified for admin & PM). KPI filter click behavior works (scaffolding tile filters to 0 rows for admin, unclick restores 152). /app/approvals, /app/scaffolding, /app/ops/requests, /app/ops/expenses all load cleanly.
